contact_edits.before: Thomson has since proved with The Patient Hour that she can write for other actors as well as for herself, and that she isn't limited to monologues. We also know that she's a fine actress in more conventional circumstances. Her Claudia, though, is unlike anything else she has done; maybe unlike anything anyone has done. It's both carefully distanced and shatteringly immediate. To watch this play and this performance is to adopt Claudia as your own child; you feel protective and you feel proud. - I, Claudia runs until May 23. Call 416-866-8666 or visit youngcentre.ca for details.
